title: Universal Weather Node — device description (/api/info)
description: What this node is and what /api/data will contain: read it once at start-up (and again after the node restarted, i.e. device.uptimeSec went down) to build your UI. Contains no secrets (no passwords, keys, station IDs, broker or coordinates). Stability: within apiVersion 1 fields are only added.

apiVersion.description: API contract version (1). Check it first: refuse or warn on an unknown major version.

system.description: Uptime and memory, for watching a node over days (a steadily falling heapMin or heapLargest points to a leak or fragmentation).

uptimeSec.description: Seconds since the last start (same as device.uptimeSec).

heapLargest.description: Largest free block now - HTTPS needs about 40 KB in one block.

language.description: Language setting of the web interface (parameter 57): auto = each browser's language, else fixed. The node's own pages follow it; a UI may too.

name.description: Device name as configured ("" = none set). Use it as the station title.

hostname.description: Host name for mDNS (reachable as <hostname>.local) and Wi-Fi/DHCP (the same name). The device name in lower case with other characters as '-' (at most 31), else weathernode-<last 6 MAC hex digits>.

uptimeSec.description: Seconds since the last restart (the history is cleared by a restart).

version.description: Firmware version (git describe, e.g. 2.0.0, 2.0.0-rc.3, 2.0.0-rc.3-4-gabc1234-dirty for development builds).

updateAvailable.description: A newer version found by the update check (= /api/data firmwareUpdate).
updateAvailable.x-present: update check on and a newer version found

boardFem.description: RF front end of a V4.
boardFem.x-present: V4 with a detected front end

pcbRev.description: PCB revision (= /api/data status.pcbRev): 12, 13 (also a board without PCB), 20 = v2.0 (also a V4 on PCB v2.0), 0 = Heltec V4 without PCB (no revision ID on GPIO15).

units.description: Units of every value in /api/data, /api/history and MQTT — always present, also when /api/data has no sibling unit field (e.g. rfSensors[] without a temperature source).

temp.description: Temperatures (temp, dewPoint, feelsLike, ds18b20, cpuTemp, rfSensors[].temp).

rain.description: Rain amounts (rain, rain1h … rainYear, rfSensors[].rainTotal, history rainMm).

cycleSec.description: Measurement (base) cycle: /api/data changes once per cycle. Default 300.

windSampleSec.description: Wind sample interval of the board anemometer.

mqttWindAggregation.description: Wind window of the MQTT payload: the MQTT interval, or the WMO 10-min mean. /api/data always uses the base cycle.

clockSynced.description: NTP time has been received since the start; without it rainToday … rainYear, lastRain and sunshine are absent.

timeZone.description: Device time zone as POSIX TZ string (defines 'today' for rainToday etc.).

range.description: Value of the range query parameter.

maxPoints.description: Ring capacity (finished buckets); plus one open bucket.

outputs.description: Enabled outputs/integrations — on/off only, no addresses or credentials.

webApi.description: Web interface/REST API enabled (true whenever you can read this).

mqtt.description: MQTT publishing enabled (same JSON as /api/data on <prefix>/data).

weatherNetworks.description: Weather networks the node uploads to.

status.x-present: always; one entry per enabled output
status.description: Send status per enabled output since start: last success / error as age, the last error's short text (local reason or trimmed server reply - never URLs or keys) and code, consecutive failures. haDiscovery = the Home Assistant discovery configs (MQTT).

wow.description: Send status of Met Office WOW.

ntfy.description: Send status of alarm notifications via ntfy.

pushover.description: Send status of alarm notifications via Pushover.

telegram.description: Send status of alarm notifications via Telegram.

webhook.description: Send status of the alarm webhook.

available.description: Value groups /api/data currently carries — build your tiles from this. Can change at run time (e.g. a wireless sensor goes silent); /api/data presence is authoritative per cycle.

pressure.description: pressureAbs/pressureQnh from the selected pressure source (BME280 or a wireless sensor).

ds18b20Probes.description: Number of DS18B20 probe slots (length of /api/data ds18b20).

wirelessSensors.description: Wireless reception on: rfSensors, sources, radioBatteryLow.

wireless.description: Wireless sensor states (settings: Mine / Received / Hidden).

onlyMine.description: Only the "Mine" sensors are accepted (setting Only my sensors, with a non-empty list).

mine.description: IDs in the "Mine" list (numbered first, wireless 1..n; Home Assistant devices).

hidden.description: IDs in the hidden list (never stored, numbered or output).

hiddenInRange.description: Hidden sensors heard within the last 10 minutes.

sources.description: Current source per value group (same format as /api/data sources, but always present).

lastOkSecAgo.description: Seconds since the last success (absent: none since start).

lastErrorSecAgo.description: Seconds since the last error (absent: none since start).

lastError.description: Last error: local reason or trimmed server reply.

lastErrorCode.description: Code of the last error: HTTP status, negative HTTP client / RadioLib code, or the MQTT client state.
